module: Gas station marker (fuel or electric charging) in play mode. For each pump (pair of scene object names: zone, icon), it creates an icon (poi_fuel_round, or poi_charge_round for an electric station) that appears when the player's vehicle, driving slowly, overlaps the pump's zone (OBB/OBB test), and makes the station interactive. The module returns {create, cluster}.
notes: cluster: one cluster per POI (id 'gasStationMarker#<poi.id>'). Reads poi.markerInfo.gasStationMarker.{pumps, electric, pos, radius}; pumps = list of {zoneName, iconName} pairs of scene objects.
The overlap is only evaluated if data.cruisingSpeedFactor < 1, i.e. below about 20 km/h (hysteresis 20 to 30 km/h).
Probable bug: setup builds the icon id with cluster.clusterId, a field that cluster() does not fill in (it sets id); all icon ids become "nil-gsIcon-N" and can collide between stations.
The icon is hidden if a static obstacle is between the camera and the icon (castRayStatic).
isInAreaChanged is "in"/"out" for one frame when the overlap changes, otherwise nil.
drawAxisBox calls color(...) as a color constructor; the function is not used anywhere in this file.

create.desc: Builds a gas station marker (instance of C).

cluster.desc: Turns each gasStationMarker POI into a distinct cluster (no merging) and adds it to allClusters.

allClusters.desc: List of clusters completed in place.

C.desc: Gas station marker with one icon per pump.

setup.desc: For each pump, finds the scene objects (zone and icon), computes the zone's box (position, scaled axes) and creates the icon with initial opacity 0.

update.desc: Every frame: tests the OBB/OBB overlap between the vehicle and each pump, raises the icon by 0.25 m and adjusts its opacity (visible if no obstacle), updates isInAreaChanged and anyOverlap.

data.desc: Frame data: veh, bbCenter, bbHalfAxis0..2, camPos, dt, cruisingSpeedFactor.

createObjects.desc: Cleans up existing objects (does not create any).

hide.desc: Becomes invisible and sets the opacity of all icons to 0.

clearObjects.desc: Removes the icons from the icon renderer and clears the pump list.

interactInPlayMode.desc: If canInteract and the vehicle is on a pump, adds the cluster's data (elemData) to the interactive elements.

drawAxisBox.desc: Draws a debug box (edges and faces) via debugDrawer.

drawOnMinimap.desc: Draws a circle on the minimap for each pump.
